name: fetch-bad-requests
about: Methods, headers and bodies the host refuses.

pages.text:
bad_request: Method TRACE isn't allowed; use GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE or HEAD
bad_request: Header Cookie isn't allowed
bad_request: Header User-Agent isn't allowed
bad_request: A GET request has no body
bad_request: The body is larger than 64 KB
bad_request: fetch(url, init): init must be an object
